messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — Nora Kim submitted her resignation today. Last day 2026-07-09. Shes US-based (WA) and on the standard benefits plan. Need COBRA timeline and stock vesting/409A notes.
Nora (leaving): Thanks Maya. Confirming I'll do a handoff doc for feature-auth before my last day. I have unexpired SSH deploy keys for infra-project and two service GCP SA keys.
Jules-IT: Noted. We need laptop return slot and whether remote wipe ok. Also, does her laptop have client data that needs secure erase?
Priya (Manager): I'll coordinate KT sessions and transfer ownership of runbooks by 2026-07-07. Please delay SSO cut until 2026-07-10 08:00 PT so Nora can wrap post-release tasks.
Maya (People Ops): COBRA note: since Nora is US employee, COBRA packet will be emailed within 2 business days after termination processed. PayrollBot will confirm enrollment window and premium amounts. Nora, HR will also send the benefits continuation notice and opt-in forms.
PayrollBot: Automated: Final payroll run scheduled 2026-07-12. Prorated salary + accrued PTO payout will be processed. COBRA packet ETA: 2 business days after termination processing. Ticket: #OPS-7901.
Nora (leaving): Question on equity: my RSUs have a 90-day exercise window post-termination? I thought Redwood recently switched to 180 for involuntary only. Any confirmation?
Maya (People Ops): Equity FAQs: standard is 90 days post-termination for voluntary departures unless specified in offer letter. I'll pull Nora's equity grant doc and DM.
Jules-IT: Proposed offboard sequence (will run runbook v4):
```
- 2026-07-09 16:30 PT: Laptop pickup / signed asset return
- 2026-07-10 08:00 PT: SSO disable (remove from all groups)
- 2026-07-10 08:05 PT: Revoke GCP service accounts and rotate downstream secrets
- 2026-07-10 08:15 PT: Revoke SSH deploy keys and CI tokens
- 2026-07-10 08:30 PT: Remove from on-call schedules and PagerDuty
- 2026-07-10 09:00 PT: Final access audit + export logs attached to #OPS-7901
```
Jules-IT: Link to runbook: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/offboard-v4
HiringOps: Also note: Priya submitted backfill req. Can HiringOps get the role brief + must-have skills by EOD so we can post 7/12?
Priya (Manager): I'll send job brief and 2 interview panel suggestions today. Requesting contractor cover for 8 weeks starting 7/10 to cover critical support.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: Maya -> confirm COBRA packet wording by 7/01; Jules-IT -> schedule laptop pickup and put courier on hold until Nora confirms address; HiringOps -> draft req once brief received.
Nora (leaving): One more thing: a shared Google Drive folder contains client PII. Priya, please make sure data is archived/removed per compliance before 7/09.
Priya (Manager): Agreed. I'll run the data removal checklist and confirm here when done.
PayrollBot: Reminder: Benefits termination code: BT-17 applied after HR closes termination. COBRA form link will be attached to ticket #OPS-7901.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll proceed with the timeline. Please update this thread when each step completes. :white_check_mark:
